dana: TL;DR from today’s all-hands security segment: SOC2 timeline, Private/VPC ops, audit logs, KMS. Capturing Qs/answers here.

maria: SOC2: will customer-specific Private installs be in the scope of our report?

dana: Short: Hosted+Dedicated in-scope for SOC2 Type II. For Private, we will provide evidence packages and point-in-time attestations but not include customer-managed infra in our hosted report.

jin: Can Private installs be configured to be fully offline? Need for gov customers.

dana: Yes. Private supports air-gapped installs. Our operator supports a no-egress mode; updates applied via offline bundles.

maria: Audit logs: is full prompt text logged by default?

dana: No. Default: metadata only. Prompt/full payload logging is opt-in per-org. We provide redaction hooks and automated PII filters.

jin: BYOK support + HSM?

dana: BYOK for AWS/GCP/Azure KMS. HSM-backed keys via customer KMS supported. Key policy must allow our service principal for envelope ops.

sam: Ops: will support need access to customer logs during incidents?

dana: Support access is entitlement-scoped and requires customer approval. We also have short-lived audit-signed access tokens for on-demand support, logged to the audit trail.

ops-bot: Recording + slides uploaded: https://redwood.company/ah/1790012345 :white_check_mark:

dana: Next actions: sam to publish SOC2 milestones; jin to update Private install docs for air-gap instructions; maria to draft audit-log opt-in template. DM to join audit WG.
